eva: Canary q6b-int4 is live in staging. Need a curated ~300 prompt subset with de-dup + a 50-sample golden for smoke evals. Prefer samples that stress long-context and codegen. Who can own selection + labeler handoff?
cheng: I can take selection. Plan: embed -> semantic clusters -> pick top-N per cluster -> filter by token-length >256. Will run fuzzyhash afterwards to nuke exact dupes. ETA ~30m.
sam: I can assemble the golden once cheng hands off. Want diversity across intents + ~10 tricky RAG cases. Any disallowed categories?
lara: Exclude PII and finance/legal. Also include some synthetic edgecases from synthbank-A/B. I'll export tags for filtering.
cheng: Running command now:
`python tools/curate/sample_select.py --embed-model mpnet-base --clusters 600 --min-tokens 256 --out /tmp/q6b_curation_1739923145.json`
cheng: After that I'll run fuzzy de-dupe:
`python tools/curate/fuzzy_dedupe.py --in /tmp/q6b_curation_1739923145.json --thresh 0.87 --out /tmp/q6b_curation_dedupe.json`
labeler-bot: labeler-bot: queued 50 tasks to workspace 'golden-review' once upload completes (:robot_face:)
eva: small addition — mark 100 samples as 'latency_probe' so infra can run the microbench (3 repeats, 100-token generation). We'll compare int4 vs q4b.
sam: will add latency_probe true on export manifest and coordinate bench script. I'll patch the bench to exclude very long ctx > 2k tokens.
cheng: I'll also add a 'near_dup' flag for any pair with cosine >0.92 so labelers can merge or mark duplicates quickly. Saves them time.
lara: can we commit the curation manifest + changelog to repo under /curation/curations/1739923145-manifest.json so Ops and audits can trace what went to the canary?
eva: yes, please. Post the manifest here when done. I'll monitor the canary results and post perf/quality numbers. If we see meaningful regression vs prod q4b, we'll open a rollback ticket and snapshot the golden. :eyes: 
sam: quick note for labelers — please prioritize examples flagged 'tricky-rag' and 'latency_probe'.
cheng: upload finished, pushing manifest to GH now -> https://git.internal/redwood/curation/curations/1739923145-manifest.json :thumbsup:
eva: awesome, thanks all. I'll kick off the quant-latency jobs when bench infra confirms warmup. If anyone finds weird overlap with previous golden sets, flag here and we'll prune.
labeler-bot: labeler-bot: golden-review tasks assigned to @lara and @sam (50 tasks).
